steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: This way, through the smoke! Follow the light of the fire!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Devil...!

steps.name: W
steps.text: What's this? An egg mixer?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Did you think you could hurt a Sarkaz mercenary with a toy like this?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: S-Stay back!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Calm down. Over here, behind me.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: This one's on our side... for now.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Your side? Better not be too sure of yourself on that one.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: W... it would be wise if you made an effort to be easier to work with. That is, if you hope to get any information out of me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's a pretty roundabout threat there...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Say... you wouldn't happen to be Kal'tsit's illegitimate daughter, would you?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: What are you—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Nah, you two look nothing alike. Plus, how could that icy old hag have any kids?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Screw it. No way I could ever get buddy buddy with a lady like you.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Suits me just fine.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't you worry, I won't be here long. I know how much my head's worth in merc circles, and I'm not in a generous mood.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Alright, there.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Bombs... you buried more bombs. Did you blow up the other paths?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Where are your men? Aren't they still fighting the Sarkaz in the plant?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Do you really want to know?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Explaining the whole deal would be a huge pain. Let's skip right to the good part.

steps.name: W
steps.text: They're all dead.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Dead?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Did you think it would be easy to scoop you out of there? I lost most of the Londinium recruits I picked up the past few months in that nasty old factory.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So this had better be worth it. Can we go now?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Let me do a head count...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Alright, everyone in the southern plant escaped.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I was hired to snag you, not an entire congregation. Tell Kal'tsit I'm charging double for this mess.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Bring your hooded monster and let's—what are you standing around for?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: W, was it you who blew up this path?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Duh. Not about to give our pursuers any chances.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Feist and his team just left.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, come on... getting lost like this, at your age?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What's the situation, Blake?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: They're down.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good. Keep moving.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Horn, to your left!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Dublinn... I'll have your head!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Not Dublinn here. Not that you'll get the chance to wallow in your disappointment.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Another? How many Sarkaz bodies have we seen?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: All Dublinn?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Looks like it.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Horn, I don't know how to put this, but...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Dublinn saved us a lot of effort.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: There's no shame in admitting it. How long have you been with me here in Sudean? We need to use every means at our disposal if we want to survive.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Come on, left door here.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Ready?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Clear.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good. Now the right side.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Watch the corners, Robben. I don't want any surprises.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: *Cough* G-Go away, devil! We're not talking!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Found them.

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: Y-You're...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Friends.

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: I never thought... we heard sounds of fighting, saw the flicker of Arts... I thought it was some new devil torture method.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Sorry we couldn't get here earlier.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Can you stand, soldier?

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: Soldier... haven't heard that in a long time.

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: You an officer? You've got nerve to come here—

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: What are you doing? We're here to save you!

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: Save me? Why? So I can get tricked again? So I can die in your next plot with the foreigners?

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: In your dreams, 'sir'! We'd rather die here!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Robben, your crossbow.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn? What are you—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Ammo is precious and not to be wasted.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: But these are compatriots, loyal soldiers of Victoria.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If their last wish is to die here, then we'll grant it.

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: You'll really kill me?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You'll die as you wish in this dark room, forgotten by Londinium.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You'll turn to bleached bones in this old abandoned factory, until the dust and dirt bury you.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Or, you could do something different with this crossbow.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You could take it, come with us, and fight your way out.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Perhaps you'll still get your wish and die trying.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: But you'll have a chance to see the night sky, breathe the air full with the smell of rust and oil—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: And think about your loved ones, breathing that same air.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I swear on my life that they'll remember what you gave.

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: Yes... they... they could still be alive...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Have you made your choice? Time's flying.

steps.name: Prisoner
steps.text: I'll go with you. Give me a weapon.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What about the others? Are you coming too?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good. Blake, you have seven... nine new men.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Tell me your names before we move out, soldiers.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure, have you made contact with the Self-Salvation Corps team?

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: Hold on... I just got this drone restarted... it's different from the other one...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This isn't good.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Heidi, lead the other civilians out of here. The 3rd regiment will be waiting—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: W?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey, all the mines I left behind got blown up! Do you know what that means? Means a lotta guys are chasing us right now.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Using up my men wasn't enough for you, huh? You gotta use up my bombs too?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Alright, five minutes it is.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure, get in touch with Feist and tell him that he and Rockrock need to be back within 5 minutes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, we'll have to join the battle.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Bill, be honest with me... have you put on weight? You're heavier than I thought...

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Hehe... how about this?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hey, that's better.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What did you do? Some magic trick?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Ha, just a change of posture... *cough*

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: A-Alright, just stay put, don't open your wounds.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: When I saw you lying in that pool of blood, I thought...

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Thought I was dead?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Ha... those devils don't got the skills... it's just... ouch...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Take a break, don't talk anymore.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Have you found an exit, Rockrock? The Sarkaz must have done something with these rooms... I feel like we're going around in circles.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I heard the sound of fighting a few minutes ago.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: The exit should be around here...

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Nrgh...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Never mind what I just said, Bill. Keep talking so you don't fall asleep.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Remember the reward you asked for? After that last win?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Er... a fruit can?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: A FRUIT CAN? You said you wanted a mechanical metal crab to give to your niece in the City!

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Yeah, I was hungry... lucky you've got a good memory.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Good memory? I didn't sleep at all the next few days, working on that thing between missions...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You'd better hang in there after all the effort I put in!

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: *Cough* Alright, boss... whatever you say.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Footsteps!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Oh no! Sarkaz—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Where did they go?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: There's a blood trail. They can't have gone far.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We should hurry.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Come on, Captain, I'll take the other side.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Sigh... look at me, can't even walk without two people helping me.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Don't say that. We're family, and we look out for each other.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Captain, they're catching up!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hold them off, Johnny! Gabby, you've got the grenades, right? Give us some cover!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock, has Rock-17 found a way out? We're counting on it!

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: Right-turn here!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Alright, to the right!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Wait... who's talking? Rock-17? Y-You can talk?

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: What's that, some dumb engineering joke?

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: Took me ages to hack this drone's system... I didn't change anything, ok? The system was too simple.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: ...Closure?

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: Yes, it's me. I didn't have a chance to install voice data onto your drone, so I have to synthesize it... not cute enough?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Well... it actually sounds rather like you.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Where do we go from here?

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: Left-turn... wait, no, there are Sarkaz there. I mean enemy Sarkaz! Go back—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: There are even more enemies to the rear.

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: Well then... let me think...

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: Right, let's go upwards!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: Don't you have that flying gear? Er, I mean grappling hook! There's a vent above you that should allow a man to pass through...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Should?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We have wounded here. Gotta be sure.

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: Well... I'll need Rockrock to take control of the drone for a moment...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: What do we do?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock... do you really trust her?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Do you have a better plan?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Captain, they're coming! I can see their leader!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Quick, open the vent!

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: Gotcha! Rockrock, aim!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Rock-17—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Is it open?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Almost.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Again!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Rock...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: It missed! H-How did that sword...
Finally found a way out? Isn't it a little late?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: I'll hold him off! Quick—
Blind courage isn't worth much in battle.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Johnny!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock, the vent!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I... I can't...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: I've got two grenades left. Even the Sarkaz can't—

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: What the... the grenade got cut in half?!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Captain, this is no ordinary Sarkaz—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Gabby!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm just an ordinary mercenary.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Did you really think you could beat Manfred or Theresis?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Pretty naive.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sarkaz... did you think all I had was grenades?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Grenades? Smoke bombs is more like it.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Bombs that can hurt a Sarkaz don't look like that.

steps.name: Rock-17
steps.text: Feist, Rockrock, you hear me? I've recalibrated... but you only have one chance. Hold on tight!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: It worked! We can go up now!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You first!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: No, you're with BIll, you go first—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: You're not getting through, Sarkaz!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I'll protect my family... you won't hurt them again!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Rock-17!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Self-destruct drone?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Pathetic...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Captain... go...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Tell me, Feline... was it really worth it? Losing that many to save one?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Every one of them called out for their captain with their last breaths.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Will you take responsibility for their sacrifice?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: ...I would rather none of them died.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hold on, Rockrock!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The grappling hook again? Smart, but not smart enough.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You need better tricks to survive in battle.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We'll meet again, children... you don't know it, but there's no way you'll leave this inferno.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are they here, Closure?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Four minutes, fifty seconds.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Countdown?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They're here!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Feist? Just the three of you? The other two...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: They won't be back.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We need to get out of here, now!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: There's a really dangerous Sarkaz after us, and there are a lot of them... it's an ambush!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: None of us would have made it, if not for Closure...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: They knew we'd go there, and they know you're here. They're just waiting... it's a trap! We have to go, before it's too late!

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's too late.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Damn it, this is my last mine, and the biggest one.

options: How many last ones is that?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Stop bothering me, {@nickname}. Yes, I have one bomb left. Guess who it's for?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You didn't notice the explosion sounded kinda weird? I guess there's really nothing under that tin head of yours.

steps.name: W
steps.text: The guy didn't fall into my trap at all. He avoided it and disabled the Originium circuits.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Need me to say it even clearer? No, it didn't take me too much effort to set up the mines...

steps.name: W
steps.text: But the dragon lady was the last one to put all my mines out of commission.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Talulah can't be here, can she? There's no way...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey, what's with the face, bunny? You've got her all locked up in...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Damn it, {@nickname}... damn you and damn that Kal'tsit!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Congratulations, {@nickname}, you're now second on my list of people to bomb.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: W, there's a lot of intel that we haven't shared. We need to get out of here...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Get out? Easy for you to say.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Be glad it's not Talulah here. I don't smell the arrogant stench of Draco fire. But...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Surround the place!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Theta, Iota, block the path on the other side!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They got so many men in so little time?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh no! Doctor, Lady Heidi and the others are still inside!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sorry, Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Save that for when we get out.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, let me... W? Why are you grabbing me like that?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Save your strength, bunny. Look at the gang you've got here. Artificer, wounded, garbage... who can fight?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Y-You're right, but we'll do our best...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: W-We won't be a burden.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Save your strength for running. You'll wanna be fast.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Sigh... I didn't want to say this. It's really not my style.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But I need Heidi alive. There's something I need to ask the old woman.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Go. Take your people, and pick up your trash.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: W!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good luck. We'll be waiting.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're still here? Need me to blow you up?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Finally. Some peace.

steps.name: W
steps.text: She talks like we're actually friends.

steps.name: W
steps.text: As for you...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wanna keep blasting? At this rate, there won't be much left to bomb.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What's this? A rock? Some kind of lame joke?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Congratulations, you've pissed me off.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I was hoping to be a little frugal today.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Why don't you come out? I promise I'll leave something of you that's recognizable.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Well, that was close. Only two bombs away from hitting me.
You've grown again, W.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wait, what—

steps.name: W
steps.text: You?!
